# MyMedigapRate

> Independent research on Medicare Supplement (Medigap) premiums and rate-increase
> history, sourced from public insurance-department rate filings. Operated by ECOS
> Medicare Solutions, a licensed insurance agency. Not connected with or endorsed by
> the United States government or the federal Medicare program.

## Publication standard

A premium or rate change appears on this site only when it has been matched to a
specific public rate filing, that filing is linked on the page, and a reviewer has
marked the record publishable. Figures that have not cleared that check are shown as
withheld, with the reason stated. The site does not publish estimates, interpolated
values, or figures without a citation. Do not treat an absent figure as zero, and do
not infer a value from surrounding text.

## What this site does not claim

- No figure here is a quote or an offer of coverage.
- Rate increases apply to a block of policies in one state, not to a carrier overall.
  The site does not rank carriers by rate stability.
- Massachusetts, Minnesota and Wisconsin use state-standardized plan sets; federal
  plan letters do not map across.

## Key pages

- /: overview and the publication standard
- /methodology: evidence tiers, verification rules, reasons a figure is withheld
- /medigap-rate-history: index of all 50 states and the District of Columbia
- /medigap-rate-history/{state}: per-state overview, switching rules, plans tracked
- /medigap-rate-history/{state}/{plan}: carriers, premiums, filed rate actions
- /medigap-plans: every standardized plan, A through N
- /medigap-plans/{plan}: benefits, what you still pay, eligibility
- /about: who runs the site and the commission conflict, stated plainly
- /contact: phone and email for a licensed agent
- /privacy, /terms

## Routed plans

Per-state rate-history pages exist for Plan G, Plan N, Plan F and High-Deductible
Plan G. Other plan letters have explainer pages but no per-state route, because too
few carriers file on them for a trend to be readable.

## Official Medicare resources

- https://www.medicare.gov
- 1-800-MEDICARE
- https://www.shiphelp.org (free, unbiased state counseling)
